description: Public product metadata of a Shopify store from its storefront products.json feed (no key): title, handle, vendor, product type, tags, publish and update times, price range, variant and image counts and product link. Only stores that expose products.json; stores that block it return 404. Takes about 20 s; allow a 45 s timeout. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: search_shopify_metadata
title: Search Shopify Metadata
